name: piposh-buddy
description: A character from Guillotine's Piposh and Rating games above your prompt, reacting to your work in their own voice.

language.title: Language
language.description: The language the characters speak: he (Hebrew, as in the games) or en (English, in the same voice).

speechModel.title: Speech model
speechModel.description: Model alias or id for the character's lines. It sees the first 300 characters of your prompt and of Claude's answer.
